author: A Vox in the Void
description:
THE INTEGRATION IS UPON US!

Join the Kickstarter for Crucible now! Early bird discounts throughout the majority of tiers. Help shape a new universe in science fiction horror.


'Crucible' is a new written and audio project from the twisted minds of author Stephen Duxbury and narrator Paul Graham: a dark, science fiction universe where horrifying flesh-integration technology has changed the world and the nature of warfare.

Biological weaponry and vat-grown monstrosities clash in a world divided by the ideological use of this technology. Truth is Rewritten, the human form is brutalised, and the very concepts of evolution and regression blur in the dystopia of the new age.
title: 'CRUCIBLE' - KICKSTARTER LAUNCH
